decisions.reason: The earmold sits close to the established hearing-care business and uses existing digital production capacity, and the firm has slack and only a year of evidence, so it has no reason for problemistic search to drop it.
The custom EARsleeve has its own page and is actively marketed as complementing universal ITE hearing systems, which signals results at or above aspiration in a core segment.

The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's established dental equipment line, has its own page, and uses existing certified processes and support, so management will keep it while early results are assessed against aspirations.
